title: Arpy Shore Topline
description: A sample-based melodic pluck lead built from the arpy dirt sample pitched into a clean reggaeton riff — chopped for stutter articulation and filtered with a slow-blooming envelope. Over 16 cycles the lpf sweeps open, the delay throws drift wider, and a pan LFO on a mutually-prime period keeps the stereo field gently swaying like a shore breeze.
code:
setcpm(98/4)
stack(
  note("<a4 c5 e5 g5 a4 c5 e5 [g5 f5]>/2").s("arpy")
    .n("<0 1 2 3>/7")
    .chop("<4 8 4 16>/4")
    .lpf(sine.slow(16).range(600, 4200))
    .resonance(sine.slow(13).range(4, 14))
    .lpenv(sine.slow(11).range(1, 6))
    .lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(sine.slow(17).range(0.08, 0.35))
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.18).sustain(0.45).release(0.12)
    .crush(sine.slow(19).range(10, 16))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .delay("0.5:0.375:0.6")
    .room(sine.slow(23).range(0.2, 0.6))
    .gain(0.85)
)
